description: Solo participant working on this challenge. Not currently looking for additional team members
summary: Analog Atlas is an interactive 3D globe that presents three lesser-known Earth sites that resemble the Moon or Mars: Danakil Depression (Ethiopia), Dasht-e Lut (Iran) and Askja (Iceland). Each site shows why it resembles its target, where the resemblance ends (gravity, atmosphere, radiation) and a simple similarity score. It helps characterize analog sites beyond the well-known ones.
details: Single-page web app built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and the globe.gl library. Tapping a pin lifts the globe and opens a card with evidence from NASA and published sources. Similarity scores are our own simple judgment, not a scientific index. This is a prototype; no datasets were processed computationally.
